title: Plan Before Implementing

upstream.note: writing-plans: Implementation plan writing skill from obra/superpowers
create-implementation-plan: Implementation plan skill from GitHub's awesome-copilot

rule: Plan mode is always on. Before implementing ANY change (feature, bug fix, refactor, configuration, dependency, migration), use the `plan-feature` skill: write the plan, present it, and wait for the user's explicit approval. Do not create, edit or delete project files until the plan is approved. Trivial changes get a 3-5 line micro-plan in chat but still need a go-ahead. The only exception is when the user explicitly says to skip planning for that request.
